records.meaning: The IPv4 address range this record describes.

Free-text description, usually the organisation using the block.
Administrative contact handle: who is responsible for the block.
Technical contact handle: who to ask about the network.
Country the holder registered for this block. It is not proof of where the servers are.
Maintainer that is allowed to change this record.
Incident-response team contact for this block.
Maintainer that may create route objects for this block.
Maintainer that may create route objects for this block.
APNIC: the block was given directly to an end user by APNIC or an NIR. It is provider-independent, so the holder can keep it when changing ISPs and announce it in BGP.
When the record was last changed.
URL of a geolocation feed (RFC 8805) where the holder publishes where each prefix is used.
Which registry database this record came from.
